title: Society, Education & Technology
sub: IELTS topic vocabulary for essays and speaking.

cards.def:
Causing harm or damage
हिंदी: हानिकारक
examples: Excessive screen time can be detrimental to children's health.
Smoking is detrimental to your lungs.
Late nights were detrimental to his exam results.
The new rule could be detrimental to small shops.

cards.def:
Producing good or helpful effects
हिंदी: लाभकारी
examples: Regular exercise is beneficial for mental wellbeing.
A short walk after lunch is beneficial for digestion.
The partnership is beneficial for both companies.
Reading to children is beneficial for their language skills.

cards.def:
Harmful or unfavourable
हिंदी: प्रतिकूल
examples: Heavy traffic has adverse effects on air quality.
The medicine had no adverse side effects.
Adverse weather delayed the flight.
The policy had an adverse impact on farmers.

cards.def:
Never done or known before
हिंदी: अभूतपूर्व
examples: The pandemic caused unprecedented disruption to education.
The city saw unprecedented rainfall this July.
The team achieved unprecedented growth this year.
Prices rose at an unprecedented rate.

cards.def:
Widespread in a particular area or time
हिंदी: प्रचलित
examples: Online shopping is prevalent in urban areas.
Diabetes is prevalent among older adults in cities.
Cash payments are still prevalent in small towns.
This belief is prevalent in many cultures.

cards.def:
Spreading widely throughout an area or group
हिंदी: हर जगह फैला हुआ
examples: Social media has become pervasive in daily life.
The smell of smoke was pervasive in the building.
Corruption was pervasive in the old system.
Advertising is pervasive on every website.

cards.def:
Present everywhere
हिंदी: सर्वव्यापी
examples: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern society.
Tea stalls are ubiquitous in Indian cities.
Plastic has become ubiquitous in our lives.
QR codes are now ubiquitous in shops.

cards.def:
Growing or increasing rapidly
हिंदी: तेज़ी से बढ़ता हुआ
examples: The burgeoning gig economy offers flexible work.
The burgeoning middle class wants better schools.
Bengaluru has a burgeoning startup scene.
Burgeoning demand for electric scooters surprised makers.

cards.def:
Rapidly increasing in intensity
हिंदी: तेज़ी से बढ़ता
examples: Escalating housing costs push families out of cities.
Escalating fuel prices hurt transport companies.
The escalating conflict forced people to flee.
Escalating tension between the two teams worried the manager.

cards.def:
Steadily increasing
हिंदी: लगातार बढ़ता
examples: There is mounting evidence of the harm of pollution.
The company faced mounting losses for two years.
There is mounting pressure on the government to act.
Mounting bills forced him to sell his car.

cards.def:
Requiring immediate attention
हिंदी: अत्यावश्यक
examples: Climate change is the most pressing issue of our time.
Unemployment is the most pressing problem for young people.
I have a pressing deadline, so I can't talk now.
The doctor dealt with the most pressing cases first.

cards.def:
Causing or likely to cause disagreement
हिंदी: विवादास्पद
examples: Genetic engineering remains a contentious subject.
The new tax was a contentious issue in parliament.
Avoid contentious topics like politics at work.
The contentious decision divided the town.

cards.def:
Open to discussion or doubt
हिंदी: बहस योग्य
examples: It is debatable whether social media improves communication.
Whether money brings happiness is debatable.
His claim that the film is the best ever is debatable.
The benefits of homework are debatable.

cards.def:
Used to indicate a point that can be supported by argument
हिंदी: तर्क के साथ कहा जाए तो
examples: Arguably, education is the most important investment a nation makes.
Sachin Tendulkar is arguably the greatest Indian batsman.
Arguably, the internet has changed society more than any other invention.
This is arguably the best biryani in the city.

cards.def:
Mainly or for the most part
हिंदी: मुख्यतः
examples: The workforce is predominantly young.
The audience was predominantly female.
The region is predominantly agricultural.
Customers are predominantly between twenty and thirty.

cards.def:
To a great or significant extent
हिंदी: काफ़ी हद तक
examples: Pollution levels have decreased substantially.
House prices have increased substantially in the last decade.
Her English improved substantially after the course.
The new road substantially reduced travel time.

cards.def:
To a very small degree
हिंदी: बहुत थोड़ा
examples: Prices rose only marginally this year.
Unemployment fell marginally last month.
The new phone is only marginally better than the old one.
Sales improved marginally after the advert.

cards.def:
In spite of what has just been said
हिंदी: तब भी
examples: The cost is high; nonetheless, the benefits justify it.
It was raining; nonetheless, the match went ahead.
The task was hard. Nonetheless, she finished it on time.
He was tired but nonetheless helped his friend move.

cards.def:
Although
हिंदी: हालाँकि
examples: Progress has been made, albeit slowly.
She accepted the offer, albeit with some doubts.
The car is reliable, albeit a little old.
It was a successful trip, albeit an expensive one.

cards.def:
In spite of
हिंदी: के बावजूद
examples: Notwithstanding the cost, many parents choose private schools.
Notwithstanding the bad weather, the event was a success.
Notwithstanding his age, he runs every morning.
The project continued, notwithstanding the budget cuts.

cards.def:
Together with
हिंदी: के साथ मिलकर
examples: Taxes should be used in conjunction with education campaigns.
The medicine works best in conjunction with a healthy diet.
We ran the event in conjunction with a local NGO.
Use this guide in conjunction with the user manual.

cards.def:
Concerning a particular matter
हिंदी: के संबंध में
examples: With regard to healthcare, access remains uneven.
With regard to your leave request, it has been approved.
I have a question with regard to the fees.
With regard to safety, helmets are compulsory.

cards.def:
Concerning a particular aspect
हिंदी: के संदर्भ में
examples: In terms of cost, online learning is cheaper.
In terms of salary, the new job is better.
The city is great in terms of food but poor in terms of traffic.
In terms of size, India is the seventh largest country.

cards.def:
Generally; for the most part
हिंदी: आम तौर पर
examples: By and large, students prefer flexible schedules.
By and large, the trip went according to plan.
By and large, people in this town are friendly.
The reviews were, by and large, positive.

cards.def:
Partly but not completely
हिंदी: एक हद तक
examples: To a certain extent, parents are responsible for children's habits.
I agree with you to a certain extent.
To a certain extent, success depends on luck.
Technology has improved our lives to a certain extent.

cards.def:
Mostly
हिंदी: काफ़ी हद तक
examples: To a large extent, success depends on access to education.
To a large extent, exam results depend on preparation.
The economy relies to a large extent on tourism.
Her recovery was, to a large extent, due to her family's support.

cards.def:
To remember and consider something
हिंदी: ध्यान में रखना
examples: We must bear in mind the costs for poorer families.
Bear in mind that the shop closes at eight.
Bear in mind that traffic is heavy on Fridays.
Please bear in mind that this is only a draft.

cards.def:
To consider when making a decision
हिंदी: ध्यान में लेना
examples: Policymakers must take long-term effects into account.
Take traffic into account when planning your trip.
The judges took her age into account.
Did you take taxes into account in the budget?

cards.def:
To cause something to happen
हिंदी: को जन्म देना
examples: Poverty gives rise to many social problems.
The new policy gave rise to many complaints.
Rapid growth can give rise to pollution.
His comments gave rise to rumours.

cards.def:
To explain or make up a proportion of something
हिंदी: हिस्सा होना / कारण बताना
examples: Transport accounts for a quarter of emissions.
Women account for half of our employees.
How do you account for the missing money?
Rent accounts for most of my monthly expenses.

cards.def:
To have a particular outcome
हिंदी: नतीजा निकलना
examples: Poor planning can result in traffic congestion.
Driving too fast can result in accidents.
The talks resulted in a new agreement.
Skipping meals often results in low energy.

cards.def:
To originate from
हिंदी: से उत्पन्न होना
examples: Many health problems stem from poor diet.
Her interest in medicine stems from her mother's illness.
Most arguments stem from misunderstandings.
The company's problems stem from poor management.

cards.def:
To help cause something
हिंदी: में योगदान देना
examples: Sedentary jobs contribute to obesity.
Everyone contributed to the farewell gift.
Lack of sleep contributes to stress.
She contributes to the company newsletter every month.

cards.def:
To start to apply or operate
हिंदी: लागू होना
examples: The new law comes into effect next year.
The new traffic fines come into effect on Monday.
The price changes will come into effect from April.
When does the new leave policy come into effect?

cards.def:
To start working or producing results
हिंदी: असर दिखाना
examples: The ban took effect immediately.
The painkiller took effect within twenty minutes.
The new timetable takes effect next week.
Changes to the rules will take effect after the election.

cards.def:
To present a danger
हिंदी: ख़तरा पैदा करना
examples: Plastic waste poses a threat to marine life.
Stray dogs can pose a threat to children.
Rising sea levels pose a threat to coastal cities.
Hackers pose a threat to online banking.

cards.def:
To present a difficulty
हिंदी: चुनौती खड़ी करना
examples: Ageing populations pose a challenge to healthcare systems.
Learning a new language can pose a challenge for adults.
Remote work poses a challenge for team bonding.
The heavy traffic posed a challenge for the ambulance.

cards.def:
To apply force or influence
हिंदी: दबाव डालना
examples: Rising costs exert pressure on household budgets.
Parents often exert pressure on children to study engineering.
Big buyers can exert pressure on suppliers to cut prices.
The weight of the snow exerted pressure on the roof.

cards.def:
To cause difficulty or strain for
हिंदी: बोझ डालना
examples: An ageing population places a burden on public services.
High school fees place a burden on middle-class families.
Extra paperwork places a burden on teachers.
Don't place a burden on others by always asking for help.

cards.def:
To reduce the severity of poverty
हिंदी: गरीबी कम करना
examples: Education helps alleviate poverty in the long run.
Microloans help alleviate poverty among women.
The government launched schemes to alleviate poverty.
Jobs, not charity, are the best way to alleviate poverty.

cards.def:
To reduce a difference between two groups
हिंदी: अंतर पाटना
examples: Online courses bridge the gap between rural and urban students.
The mentor programme helps bridge the gap between college and work.
We need to bridge the gap between what customers want and what we offer.
Free Wi-Fi helps bridge the gap for poorer students.

cards.def:
To increase a difference
हिंदी: अंतर बढ़ाना
examples: Digital divides widen the gap between rich and poor.
Expensive coaching can widen the gap between rich and poor students.
Automation may widen the gap between skilled and unskilled workers.
Ignoring the issue will only widen the gap between the teams.

cards.def:
To create fair conditions for everyone
हिंदी: समान अवसर देना
examples: Scholarships level the playing field for talented students.
Free online courses level the playing field for students.
The new rules aim to level the playing field for small businesses.
Blind interviews help level the playing field.

cards.def:
A situation where one problem worsens another repeatedly
हिंदी: दुष्चक्र
examples: Poverty and poor education create a vicious circle.
Stress and poor sleep can become a vicious circle.
Borrowing to repay old loans is a vicious circle.
Low pay and low motivation create a vicious circle.

cards.def:
Increasing research supporting a claim
हिंदी: बढ़ते प्रमाण
examples: A growing body of evidence links sleep and productivity.
A growing body of evidence shows that exercise helps memory.
There is a growing body of evidence on the harm of sugar.
A growing body of evidence supports early education.

cards.def:
Many different kinds of
हिंदी: विभिन्न प्रकार के
examples: The course offers a wide range of subjects.
The shop sells a wide range of spices.
We discussed a wide range of topics.
The job requires a wide range of skills.

cards.def:
Nearly all of a group
हिंदी: विशाल बहुमत
examples: The vast majority of students own a smartphone.
The vast majority of people use UPI for payments.
The vast majority of employees supported the change.
In the vast majority of cases, the problem is a loose cable.

cards.def:
A large part of a whole
हिंदी: एक बड़ा हिस्सा
examples: A significant proportion of income goes on rent.
A significant proportion of graduates work in IT.
A significant proportion of our sales comes from online orders.
Food takes a significant proportion of a poor family's budget.

cards.def:
A very small part
हिंदी: नगण्य अल्पसंख्यक
examples: Only a negligible minority opposed the plan.
Only a negligible minority of customers complained.
A negligible minority voted against the proposal.
Cheating is done by a negligible minority of students.

cards.def:
For each person
हिंदी: प्रति व्यक्ति
examples: Income per capita has doubled in two decades.
Water use per capita is high in big cities.
The country's per capita income is still low.
Per capita spending on health has increased.

cards.def:
A particular section of the population
हिंदी: जनसांख्यिकीय वर्ग
examples: The app targets a younger demographic.
The show is popular with an older demographic.
Brands want to reach the youth demographic.
Demographic changes affect housing demand.

cards.def:
Useful facilities provided for convenience
हिंदी: सुविधाएँ
examples: Cities offer better amenities than villages.
The apartment has amenities like a gym and a pool.
Small towns often lack basic amenities.
Good amenities attract tenants.

cards.def:
Regular travel between home and work
हिंदी: रोज़ आना-जाना
examples: Long commuting times reduce quality of life.
Commuting by metro saves me an hour every day.
Daily commuting in heavy traffic is tiring.
Remote work cut down commuting for many employees.

cards.def:
Easy to reach, use or obtain
हिंदी: सुलभ
examples: Online resources make education more accessible.
The building is accessible for wheelchair users.
The village is only accessible by boat.
Make your website accessible to people with poor eyesight.

cards.def:
Money paid for teaching
हिंदी: पढ़ाई की फ़ीस
examples: Rising tuition fees discourage poorer students.
Tuition fees at private universities are very high.
She took a loan to pay her tuition fees.
The scholarship covers all tuition fees.

cards.def:
The proportion of students who leave before finishing
हिंदी: पढ़ाई छोड़ने की दर
examples: The dropout rate is highest in rural schools.
Free school meals reduced the dropout rate.
The dropout rate is higher among girls in some areas.
Online courses often have a high dropout rate.

cards.def:
How well a student does in studies
हिंदी: शैक्षणिक प्रदर्शन
examples: Sleep affects academic performance.
Regular attendance improves academic performance.
Her academic performance won her a scholarship.
Stress at home can affect academic performance.

cards.def:
Activities outside the normal curriculum
हिंदी: पाठ्येतर
examples: Extracurricular activities build teamwork.
He joined the drama club as an extracurricular activity.
Colleges look at extracurricular achievements too.
Extracurricular sports helped her make friends.

cards.def:
Differences in attitudes between older and younger people
हिंदी: पीढ़ियों का अंतर
examples: The generation gap affects views on technology.
The generation gap shows when grandparents and teens discuss careers.
Music taste is a classic example of the generation gap.
Talking openly can help close the generation gap.

cards.def:
A family of parents and children only
हिंदी: एकल परिवार
examples: The nuclear family is now common in cities.
After marriage, they moved out and started a nuclear family.
In a nuclear family, both parents often work.
Nuclear families have less help with childcare.

cards.def:
A family including grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins
हिंदी: संयुक्त परिवार
examples: Extended families provide strong social support.
My extended family meets every Diwali.
Living with an extended family means there's always someone to help.
The wedding invited the whole extended family.

cards.def:
The bonds that hold a community together
हिंदी: सामाजिक एकजुटता
examples: Shared festivals promote social cohesion.
Community kitchens build social cohesion in the neighbourhood.
Sports events can strengthen social cohesion.
Inequality weakens social cohesion.

cards.def:
In unfavourable circumstances
हिंदी: वंचित
examples: Disadvantaged children need extra support.
The scheme gives scholarships to disadvantaged students.
Disadvantaged areas need better schools.
She works with disadvantaged women in villages.

cards.def:
Having less money and fewer opportunities
हिंदी: कम सुविधा प्राप्त
examples: The charity supports underprivileged families.
The school offers free seats to underprivileged children.
Volunteers teach underprivileged kids on weekends.
Underprivileged families often lack internet access.

cards.def:
Lacking basic necessities
हिंदी: अभावग्रस्त
examples: Deprived areas have fewer healthcare facilities.
Many children in deprived areas miss school to work.
The report focused on the most deprived districts.
She grew up in a deprived neighbourhood but became a doctor.

cards.def:
A sense of belonging to a culture
हिंदी: सांस्कृतिक पहचान
examples: Migrants often struggle to preserve their cultural identity.
Language is an important part of cultural identity.
Festivals help children connect with their cultural identity.
Living abroad made me think about my cultural identity.

cards.def:
The increasing connection of economies and cultures worldwide
हिंदी: वैश्वीकरण
examples: Globalisation has created new job markets.
Globalisation brought foreign brands to Indian malls.
Critics say globalisation hurts local farmers.
Globalisation made it easy to work with global clients.

cards.def:
Traditions and monuments inherited from the past
हिंदी: सांस्कृतिक विरासत
examples: Governments must protect cultural heritage.
Folk music is part of our cultural heritage.
The city's old buildings reflect its cultural heritage.
UNESCO helps protect cultural heritage worldwide.

cards.def:
The process of adopting a new culture
हिंदी: नई संस्कृति में घुल-मिल जाना
examples: Language classes aid assimilation of newcomers.
Assimilation can be hard for older migrants.
Assimilation doesn't mean giving up your own culture.
Schools play a big role in the assimilation of immigrant children.

cards.def:
Making things uniform or similar
हिंदी: एकरूपता
examples: Globalisation may cause cultural homogenisation.
The homogenisation of shopping malls makes every city look the same.
Some fear the homogenisation of food culture.
Global media leads to homogenisation of fashion.

cards.def:
The process of becoming outdated
हिंदी: अप्रचलन
examples: Rapid obsolescence of devices creates electronic waste.
Obsolescence is a big risk in the electronics business.
The factory's machines face obsolescence within a decade.
Skills obsolescence pushes workers to keep learning.

cards.def:
Using the latest available technology
हिंदी: अत्याधुनिक
examples: The hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
The new stadium has state-of-the-art lighting.
Our office uses state-of-the-art video conferencing.
The lab is equipped with state-of-the-art machines.

cards.def:
An incident where confidential data is exposed
हिंदी: डेटा लीक की घटना
examples: The company suffered a major data breach.
After the data breach, customers were told to change passwords.
A data breach can damage a company's reputation.
The hospital reported a data breach to the authorities.

cards.def:
Involving much sitting and little exercise
हिंदी: गतिहीन
examples: A sedentary lifestyle increases health risks.
Desk jobs are mostly sedentary.
Older people with sedentary habits need gentle exercise.
Gaming has made many children more sedentary.

cards.def:
Working from home using technology
हिंदी: घर से काम करना
examples: Telecommuting reduces commuting stress.
Telecommuting became normal after the pandemic.
Telecommuting helps parents spend more time with children.
Some managers still don't trust telecommuting.

cards.def:
The assurance of keeping one's job
हिंदी: नौकरी की सुरक्षा
examples: Many workers value job security over high pay.
Government jobs are popular for their job security.
Job security is low in many startups.
The union is fighting for job security for contract workers.

cards.def:
The supply of and demand for workers
हिंदी: श्रम बाज़ार
examples: Skills shortages are tightening the labour market.
The labour market for data scientists is very competitive.
Women are joining the labour market in larger numbers.
Automation is changing the labour market.

cards.def:
A lack of workers with required skills
हिंदी: कुशल कर्मियों की कमी
examples: A skills shortage slows technology projects.
There's a skills shortage of nurses in many countries.
Companies train freshers to fix the skills shortage.
A skills shortage pushed up salaries for cloud engineers.

cards.def:
The money needed for basic expenses
हिंदी: जीवन-यापन की लागत
examples: The cost of living is rising faster than wages.
The cost of living in Mumbai is very high.
Salaries should rise with the cost of living.
Many students move to smaller cities to reduce the cost of living.

cards.def:
The level of wealth and comfort a group enjoys
हिंदी: जीवन स्तर
examples: Economic growth raises the standard of living.
The standard of living has improved in most villages.
A good job helps raise your family's standard of living.
The country's standard of living is among the highest in the world.

cards.def:
The general wellbeing of individuals
हिंदी: जीवन की गुणवत्ता
examples: Green spaces improve quality of life.
Less commuting improved my quality of life.
Clean air is important for quality of life.
The city ranks high on quality of life surveys.

cards.def:
A population in which older people form a growing share
हिंदी: बढ़ती बुज़ुर्ग आबादी
examples: An ageing population increases pension costs.
Japan has an ageing population and few young workers.
An ageing population needs more healthcare services.
Kerala is seeing an ageing population as young people move abroad.

cards.def:
The number of births per thousand people
हिंदी: जन्म दर
examples: Falling birth rates affect future workforces.
The birth rate has fallen in most Indian states.
A low birth rate can lead to labour shortages.
Better education for girls lowers the birth rate.

cards.def:
Excessive number of people for available resources
हिंदी: अत्यधिक जनसंख्या
examples: Overpopulation puts pressure on food supplies.
Overpopulation leads to crowded trains and schools.
Some experts say overpopulation is less of a threat than overconsumption.
Overpopulation in cities strains the water supply.

cards.def:
Action by the state to influence the economy or society
हिंदी: सरकारी हस्तक्षेप
examples: Government intervention may be needed to protect consumers.
Government intervention kept onion prices from rising further.
Some people oppose government intervention in business.
Without government intervention, the bank would have failed.

cards.def:
To officially introduce a rule or tax
हिंदी: थोपना / लागू करना
examples: The government imposed a tax on sugary drinks.
The school imposed a strict no-phone rule.
The city imposed fines for littering.
Don't impose your opinions on others.

cards.def:
To support with public money
हिंदी: सब्सिडी देना
examples: The state subsidises public transport.
The government subsidises cooking gas for poor families.
Should the state subsidise higher education?
The company subsidises lunch in the canteen.

cards.def:
To punish or put at a disadvantage
हिंदी: दंडित करना
examples: Companies should be penalised for polluting rivers.
Students are penalised for late submissions.
Drivers will be penalised for not wearing seat belts.
The tax system shouldn't penalise people who save.

cards.def:
To encourage through rewards
हिंदी: प्रोत्साहन देना
examples: Tax breaks incentivise renewable energy.
The company incentivises employees to cycle to work.
Discounts incentivise customers to pay online.
We should incentivise teachers to work in rural schools.

cards.def:
To discourage from doing something
हिंदी: हतोत्साहित करना
examples: Heavy fines deter illegal dumping.
CCTV cameras deter thieves.
High prices deter people from buying new cars.
Strict rules deter students from cheating.

cards.def:
To limit or control
हिंदी: सीमित करना
examples: Governments restrict the sale of tobacco to minors.
The building restricts entry to staff only.
Doctors restricted his salt intake.
Some apps restrict access for users under eighteen.

cards.def:
Illegal behaviour by young people
हिंदी: किशोर अपराध
examples: Poverty is linked to juvenile delinquency.
Sports programmes can reduce juvenile delinquency.
Juvenile delinquency rose in areas with high unemployment.
The court handles juvenile delinquency cases separately.

cards.def:
Between different generations
हिंदी: पीढ़ियों के बीच का
examples: Intergenerational poverty is hard to break.
Intergenerational families share homes and childcare.
The project encourages intergenerational learning.
Intergenerational wealth gives some families a head start.

cards.def:
A change in the make-up of a population
हिंदी: आबादी की संरचना में बदलाव
examples: A demographic shift is reshaping the labour market.
The demographic shift towards cities is changing village life.
A demographic shift means more elderly voters.
Businesses must adapt to the demographic shift.

cards.def:
Individual freedoms protected by law
हिंदी: नागरिक स्वतंत्रताएँ
examples: Surveillance laws threaten civil liberties.
Protecting civil liberties is a duty of the courts.
Some security laws limit civil liberties.
Citizens protested to defend their civil liberties.

cards.def:
The right to voice opinions without censorship
हिंदी: अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता
examples: Freedom of expression underpins democracy.
Freedom of expression has limits, such as hate speech.
Journalists rely on freedom of expression.
Students debated freedom of expression on social media.

cards.def:
A law requiring openness from institutions
हिंदी: पारदर्शिता क़ानून
examples: Transparency laws help citizens hold officials accountable.
The transparency law requires officials to declare their assets.
Under the transparency law, contracts are published online.
Activists campaigned for a stronger transparency law.

cards.def:
Favouring relatives in appointments
हिंदी: भाई-भतीजावाद
examples: Nepotism harms fair recruitment.
The company was accused of nepotism in hiring.
Nepotism in film industries is widely debated.
Clear hiring rules help prevent nepotism.

cards.def:
A system where advancement is based on ability
हिंदी: योग्यता आधारित व्यवस्था
examples: A meritocracy rewards talent and effort.
The exam system is meant to be a meritocracy.
Critics say true meritocracy ignores unequal opportunities.
A meritocracy rewards results, not connections.

cards.def:
Rules ensuring that people answer for their actions
हिंदी: जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करने के उपाय
examples: Stronger accountability measures are needed in public bodies.
New accountability measures require monthly reports from managers.
Accountability measures reduced corruption in the department.
Schools introduced accountability measures for teacher attendance.

cards.def:
People who create rules and plans for governance
हिंदी: नीति निर्माता
examples: Policy-makers must consider long-term effects.
Policy-makers met with farmers before changing the rules.
Policy-makers must listen to scientists on climate issues.
The report gives advice to policy-makers on education.

cards.def:
The proportion of eligible people who vote
हिंदी: मतदान प्रतिशत
examples: Voter turnout rose among young people.
Voter turnout was low because of the heat.
Campaigns on social media raised voter turnout.
High voter turnout shows a healthy democracy.

cards.def:
Changes to the way elections are held
हिंदी: चुनाव सुधार
examples: Electoral reform could reduce polarisation.
Electoral reform is a hot topic before every election.
Some parties support electoral reform to make voting fairer.
Electoral reform could include online voting.

cards.def:
Asking citizens for views on proposals
हिंदी: जनता से राय लेना
examples: A public consultation preceded the policy.
The city held a public consultation on the new flyover.
Residents shared their concerns during the public consultation.
The plan changed after public consultation.

cards.def:
Transferring power from central to local authorities
हिंदी: सत्ता का विकेंद्रीकरण
examples: Decentralisation improves local decision-making.
Decentralisation gave village councils more power.
Decentralisation helped the company respond faster to local needs.
Some argue decentralisation leads to unequal services.

cards.def:
Uncontrolled expansion of urban areas
हिंदी: शहरों का अनियंत्रित फैलाव
examples: Urban sprawl increases commuting time.
Urban sprawl has swallowed farmland around the city.
Urban sprawl makes public transport hard to plan.
Planners want to control urban sprawl with green belts.

cards.def:
Wealthier people moving into poorer areas and raising costs
हिंदी: ग़रीब इलाक़ों में अमीरों के आने से महँगाई
examples: Gentrification displaced long-term residents.
Gentrification brought cafes but pushed up rents.
Long-time shopkeepers left because of gentrification.
The debate about gentrification is growing in big cities.

cards.def:
Large-scale public transport systems
हिंदी: बड़े पैमाने की सार्वजनिक परिवहन व्यवस्था
examples: Mass transit eases congestion in big cities.
Mass transit like the metro reduces air pollution.
Delhi's mass transit system carries millions daily.
Cities should invest more in mass transit.

cards.def:
A tax on greenhouse gas emissions
हिंदी: कार्बन उत्सर्जन पर कर
examples: A carbon tax encourages cleaner production.
A carbon tax raises the price of petrol.
Some countries use carbon tax money for green projects.
Industry groups oppose the new carbon tax.

cards.def:
A fee for driving in busy areas
हिंदी: भीड़भाड़ वाले इलाक़े में गाड़ी चलाने का शुल्क
examples: A congestion charge cut traffic in the centre.
London has a congestion charge for driving in the centre.
A congestion charge could reduce traffic in Bengaluru.
Drivers pay the congestion charge online.

cards.def:
Electronic devices worn on the body
हिंदी: पहनने योग्य तकनीक
examples: Wearable technology tracks health data.
Smartwatches are the most common wearable technology.
Wearable technology can alert doctors to heart problems.
Athletes use wearable technology to track performance.

cards.def:
Creating an identical copy of an organism
हिंदी: क्लोनिंग
examples: Human cloning is banned in many countries.
Dolly the sheep was the first mammal created by cloning.
Cloning raises many ethical questions.
Scientists use cloning to study diseases.

cards.def:
Unfair outcomes produced by automated systems
हिंदी: एल्गोरिदम में निहित पक्षपात
examples: Algorithmic bias can discriminate in hiring.
Algorithmic bias can affect who gets a loan.
Testing for algorithmic bias should be routine.
The face recognition system showed algorithmic bias.

cards.def:
A situation requiring a difficult moral choice
हिंदी: नैतिक दुविधा
examples: Self-driving cars pose an ethical dilemma.
Doctors face an ethical dilemma when resources are limited.
Reporting a friend's mistake was an ethical dilemma for her.
The class discussed an ethical dilemma in journalism.

cards.def:
Software whose code is freely available
हिंदी: खुला स्रोत
examples: Open-source tools lowered our costs.
Linux is a famous open-source operating system.
Many developers contribute to open-source projects.
Open-source software can be used and changed freely.
